articles.title: Mae Jemison: The First Black Woman in Space
articles.summary: On September 12, 1992, Mae Jemison became the first African American woman in space aboard the shuttle Endeavour. She spent 8 days in orbit, conducted 44 experiments, and later appeared on Star Trek.

articles.title: Sound Waves May Solve a Major Quantum Computing Problem
articles.summary: Harvard researchers used microscopic sound waves called phonons to protect fragile quantum information. The technique could enable smaller, more powerful quantum computers and networks on a chip.

articles.title: Wasps Are Vanishing This Summer, and Scientists Are Alarmed
articles.summary: In the UK, wasps are mysteriously absent this summer. Extreme heatwaves may be killing them or stunting their growth. Scientists warn their disappearance could harm ecosystems.
